changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE resale_holds; DROP INDEX uq_resale_listings_one_live; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_resale_listings_one_live ON resale_listings (transaction_id) WHERE status IN ('AWAITING_CONSENT', 'LISTED'); ALTER TABLE resale_listings DROP CONSTRAINT chk_resale_listings_live, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_resale_listings_closed, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_resale_listings_status; ALTER TABLE resale_listings ADD CONSTRAINT chk_resale_listings_status CHECK (status IN ('AWAITING_CONSENT', 'LISTED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'EXPIRED', 'ENDED', 'REFUSED')), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_resale_listings_closed CHECK ( (status IN ('AWAITING_CONSENT', 'LISTED')) = (closed_at IS NULL) AND (status = 'ENDED') = (close_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (status = 'REFUSED') = (refusal_reason IS NOT NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_resale_listings_live CHECK ( (listed_at IS NULL) = (expires_at IS NULL) AND (status <> 'LISTED' OR listed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'AWAITING_CONSENT' OR listed_at IS NULL)); DROP INDEX idx_reservations_resale_of; DROP INDEX uq_reservations_one_active_resale_hold; ALTER TABLE reservations DROP CONSTRAINT chk_reservations_resale, ALTER COLUMN previous_plot_status SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN price_tier_id SET NOT NULL, DROP COLUMN resale_of_transaction_id, DROP COLUMN resale_listing_id;
